We’re sorry the drops keep happening. We’ve shipped a replacement mesh node to 555 Murphy Lane, Networkville, ST 12121 via overnight delivery. You’ll receive a return label and setup instructions in this email—simply swap in the new node and return the old unit in the prepaid box.

Please let me know once it’s installed or if you need anything else!

Thanks,
TechMart Support Team
